text:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-prod queue depth > 95th percentile for 6m, 503 spike ~2% over baseline. Affected route: /v1/generate. Paging eng-oncall.

Tara S.: oncall here, seeing increased 503s and elevated latency for long-context requests. impact: a handful of enterprise customers report errors.

Mike L.: i'm looking. any recent deploys?

Jules P.: no deploys to runtime in the last 30m. infra metrics show GPU workers hitting max_in_flight limit and RT tail.

Tara S.: ok, quick mitigation options: 1) apply temporary rate-limit on generate route 2) tighten per-key concurrency (max_in_flight) 3) disable long-context feature flag for heavy routes 4) increase request timeout to avoid building giant queues. propose doing 1+2 asap.

Mike L.: +1. I'll flip rate-limit at the ingress. planning: cap global to 900r/s and per-key to 20 concurrent.

Jules P.: will patch runtime config for max_in_flight shedding and shorten backend timeout.

Tara S.: Kira (CS) can you surface which customers are hitting 503s? we need SRE impact assessment for pager escalation.

Kira (CS): on it, pulling IDs now. Looks like cust-acme and cust-luma have alerts. Luma seeing batch jobs time out. ACME has 1 degraded endpoint.

Mike L.: applying edge rate-limit now. command:```bash
redwoodctl traffic patch --route /v1/generate --set rate_limit=900 --burst=1200
```

infra-bot: Deploy job started: traffic-patch-1955550000 by Mike L. CI job 8921.

Jules P.: runtime patch for shedding:```yaml
runtime:
  routes:
    /v1/generate:
      max_in_flight_per_key: 20
      global_max_in_flight: 2500
      queue_timeout_ms: 1200
      shed_when_queue_full: true
```applying via redwoodctl now.

Tara S.: Mike, after rate-limit goes in, watch errors and 95th latency. If 503s persist we disable streaming or long-context features for enterprise customers.

Mike L.: rate-limit applied. infra-bot reports success. initial traffic drop ~18% on the route, error spike dropping.

Jules P.: runtime config applied, reducing max in-flight per key from 45 -> 20. queue_timeout set to 1200ms. shedding enabled.

Tara S.: monitoring... 503s down to 0.6% in the last 2m, tail latency improving. good.

Kira (CS): notifying affected customers: ACME incident reported; Luma on standby. CS will open incident notes and coordinate updates.

Jules P.: quick note on tradeoffs: shedding will start rejecting high-concurrency callers earlier; may produce 429s for some background jobs. we should route critical customers to dedicated capacity if they need sustained high concurrency.

Tara S.: agree. action items: 1) keep rate-limit and shedding for 2 hours 2) correlate logs for rejected keys and surface top offenders 3) oncall handoff at 04:00 UTC with summary 4) follow-up to consider autoscale/burst policy changes and quota increases for trusted customers.

Mike L.: capturing logs:```bash
redwoodctl logs query --route /v1/generate --filter "response_code>=429 or response_code>=503" --since 15m > /tmp/err_dump_195555.log
```pushing to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1955550000/err_dump_195555.log

Tara S.: Jules, please keep an eye on fallback model variants. if a worker OOM or kernel stalls appear, we'll route to smaller model.

Jules P.: noted. added an automated fallback policy: if avg token_time > 300ms for 60s, route to model-small-v2 for non-enterprise keys. config:```json
{"fallback":{"condition":{"avg_token_ms":300,"window_s":60},"target":"model-small-v2"}}
```

infra-bot: fallback policy deployment succeeded.

Kira (CS): update: ACME acknowledged. they accept reduced throughput for now; Luma requests ETA for full recovery.

Tara S.: good. writing incident summary in Ops and linking runbook. Looks like root cause: hot traffic from a few high-concurrency customers combined with long-context requests pushed runtime past safe concurrency thresholds; lack of more aggressive per-key limits allowed queues to build.

Jules P.: follow-ups: - propose lowering default max_in_flight_per_key to 30 and enable per-key adaptive throttling - add metric alert for sustained global queue depth > 80% - improve docs for feature-flagging long-context streaming.

Tara S.: agree. handing off to Zayd for the overnight watch. Zayd, please monitor SLOs for next 3h and escalate if 503s > 1% or 429s > 5% for more than 10m.

Zayd A.: picking up handoff. I have the runbook and current patches noted. will check dashboards every 10m and investigate any regressions.

Tara S.: thanks team. final mitigation snapshot: rate-limit 900r/s global, per-key max_in_flight 20, queue_timeout 1200ms, shedding enabled, fallback to model-small-v2 on sustained slow tokens. I'll remove the temp rate-limit after we confirm stable for 2 hours.

Mike L.: adding a follow-up ticket: OPS-4281 "Adaptive per-key throttling + default reductions" and assigning to eng-runtime.

Jules P.: leaving a note: watch for increased 429 volume vs 503 - expected tradeoff.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, mitigation=rate_limit+shedding+fallback, duration=~12m so far.

Tara S.: handing thread to Zayd for overnight. if anything pops, ping /call Zayd. :phone: :white_check_mark:

Zayd A.: ack. I'll update first_message_ts if needed and file a short postmortem if trend reappears.

Kira (CS): CS will send customer postmortem updates and offer credits if SLA impacted.

Tara S.: thanks everyone. closing the active paging loop.
